### STEP 1 — Scene
A tortilla wrap with visible pale meat (likely chicken), carrot and leafy salad; a bowl of mixed fruit; a small seeded cookie; milky coffee or tea; and water.

### STEP 2 — Vessels
Estimated sizes and areas:
- Wrap plate: **24 cm**, area **452 cm²**.
- Fruit bowl: **16 cm**, area **201 cm²**.
- Cookie rests on the napkin; estimated footprint **28 cm²**.
- Mug interior: **8 cm**, area **50 cm²**.
- Water glass interior: **7 cm**, area **38.5 cm²**.

### STEP 3 — Items
The wrap is estimated as one assembled item, including its visible filling. Fruit appears to include green grapes, cantaloupe, watermelon and strawberries. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible.

### STEPS 4–7 — Coverage, volume, weight and energy
Heights are average food-envelope heights. Bulk density is the only volume-to-weight adjustment.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × height = volume | Density (g/ml) | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Filled tortilla wrap | 31% of plate | 140 × 1.9 = 266 ml | 0.90 | 240 g | 190 | 456 kcal |
| Green grapes | 22% of bowl | 44 × 2.2 = 97 ml | 0.65 | 63 g | 69 | 43 kcal |
| Cantaloupe | 20% of bowl | 40 × 2.2 = 88 ml | 0.65 | 58 g | 34 | 20 kcal |
| Watermelon | 17% of bowl | 34 × 2.2 = 75 ml | 0.65 | 49 g | 30 | 15 kcal |
| Strawberries | 11% of bowl | 22 × 2.2 = 48 ml | 0.65 | 32 g | 32 | 10 kcal |
| Seeded cookie | 100% of its footprint | 28 × 0.8 = 22 ml | 0.90 | 20 g | 460 | 92 kcal |
| Milky coffee/tea | 100% of liquid surface | 50 × 4.0 = 200 ml | 1.00 | 201 g | 20 | 40 kcal |
| Water | 100% of liquid surface | 38.5 × 4.5 = 173 ml | 1.00 | 173 g | 0 | 0 kcal |

Coverage check: the wrap covers approximately **31% of its plate**; fruit coverage adds to **70% of its bowl**.

### STEP 8 — Sanity check
Estimated solid food is **462 g**, reasonable for the substantial wrap, modest fruit bowl and small cookie. Including drinks, the visible meal weighs approximately **836 g** and provides **676 kcal**. Wrap filling and milk content are the largest uncertainties; no unseen sugar is included.
